The '''2026 Idaho gubernatorial election''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect the [[governor of Idaho]]. [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] incumbent [[Brad Little]] is seeking a third term. He is being challenged by [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] attorney Terri Pickens.

[[Primary elections]] took place on May 19, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web|date=May 9, 2025|title=2026 State Primary Election Dates|url=https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2026-state-primary-election-dates|website=[[National Conference of State Legislatures]]|access-date=5 August 2025}}</ref>
